fields.name: modification_type
fields.rationale: The dataset explicitly identifies the product as acetylated wood in the dataset name and category, which is a primary discriminating material property.

fields.name: feedstock_species_group
fields.rationale: The technology description states that dried softwood is used as the feedstock, which differentiates mechanical/biological properties and supply-chain impacts.
evidence: Technology description: "For the production of acetylated wood, dried softwood is used for this data set."

fields.name: outdoor_suitable
fields.rationale: The technical purpose notes that acetylated wood is mainly used outdoors and in soil/water contact due to improved durability, indicating suitability for outdoor applications.
evidence: Technical purpose of product or process: "Acetylated wood can be used for structural and non-structural applications. Due to the improved durability, acetylated wood is mainly used outdoors, as well as for applications with soil and water contact."

fields.name: uses_acetic_anhydride
fields.rationale: The acetylation process description explains that an acetic anhydride solution is injected and reacted with the wood, indicating acetic anhydride is a key chemical input.
evidence: Technology description: "For the acetylation process, an acetic anhydride solution is injected into special stainless steel reactors filled with the wood to be treated."

fields.name: end_of_life_primary_treatment
fields.rationale: Module C3 explicitly accounts for grinding and thermal treatment (combustion) of the material and Module D contains credits from energy substitution, so the primary EoL pathway modeled is combustion with energy recovery.
evidence: Technology description: "Module C3 takes into account the grinding and thermal treatment (combustion) of the material."
Technology description: "Module D contains the credits for the substitution of electricity (German electricity mix) and thermal energy (from natural gas)."

fields.name: product_form
fields.rationale: Although not stated as a single explicit label, cues in the dataset (reference to EN 16485 for round and sawn timber, a declared volume of 1 m3, and description of reactors filled with wood pieces) suggest the product is solid sawn/round timber rather than panels.
evidence: General comment: reference to EN 16485: "Round and sawn timber - Environmental Product Declarations - Product category rules for wood and wood-based products for use in construction, 2014"
Technology description: "... reactors filled with the wood to be treated."
inference_basis: Reference to EN 16485 (round and sawn timber) implies the product belongs to the sawn/solid timber category.
Declared functional unit as 1 m3 and process description (reactors filled with wood) are more consistent with solid wood pieces than panels or engineered products.
